# @amykit/plugin-terminal-conversation

The person's terminal as an amy conversation: asks post to stdout, and answers come back as a line or a number.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy). It provides the `conversation` port.

Use it when a workflow should ask its questions in the terminal amy runs in. It mounts the conversation port on stdin and stdout: an ask is printed, and the answer is a line or a number typed back. amy setup mounts it for the setup workflow, so the questions arrive where you typed the command.

## What it extends

|  |  |
| :-- | :-- |
| Ports | `conversation` |
| Actions | _none_ |
| Operations | _none_ |
| Commands | _none_ |
| Events | _none_ |
| Environment | _none_ |

## Install

```sh
amy add @amykit/plugin-terminal-conversation
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/plugin-terminal-conversation"
```

## Configuration

This package declares no settings. A config that gives it some is refused at boot,
because a setting nobody reads is one somebody believes is working.
